name: build-orchestrator help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:build-orchestrator. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Only
entries.text: Shows only this kind.

entries.title: Keep
entries.text: Keeps this step in the build.

entries.title: Add note
entries.text: Adds a note to this build, for you or the next session.

entries.title: Save rules
entries.text: Saves the token rules every session follows.

entries.title: Hidden
entries.text: Builds you hid from the list. Tap to see them.

entries.title: Approve upgrade
entries.text: Approves raising the next phase to a stronger model (Opus to Fable). Only Brett's own click counts; a downgrade needs no approval.

entries.title: Approve upgrade
entries.text: Approves the waiting model upgrade request for this phase. Only Brett's own click counts; it is recorded with his name.

entries.title: Queue
entries.text: Sends this Pending build to the Queue. The dispatcher starts it when a VPS slot and a Claude account for its next step's model are free; it never starts right away.

entries.title: Back to Pending
entries.text: Takes a queued build out of the Queue before it starts.

entries.title: Split now
entries.text: Asks the orchestrator to split this build into steps of 10 minutes or less (Fable only where needed, Opus otherwise). Done by the dispatcher within a minute.

entries.title: Toggle Fable
entries.text: Says by hand whether this Claude account can run Fable: on, off, or back to auto (the plan, or a probe).

entries.title: More parallel
entries.text: Lets one more build run on this account at once.

entries.title: Less parallel
entries.text: One fewer build at once on this account.

entries.title: Toggle use
entries.text: Takes this account out of the pipeline, or puts it back.

entries.title: API overflow
entries.text: When every subscription account is full or out, the orchestrator sends the next build to an API-key account (billed per token, under its daily and weekly caps). Off by default; only your own click turns it on.

entries.title: Build queue
entries.text: Opens the Build orchestrator on the Queue: every queued build in start order, with its steps and the planned model and account.

entries.title: Building now
entries.text: Opens the Build orchestrator on Active: what is building now and which account took each build.

entries.title: Build errors
entries.text: Opens the Build orchestrator on Errors: failed builds and builds whose launch failed, with the accounts that refused them.

entries.title: Claude account health
entries.text: Opens the Build orchestrator on Accounts: the 5-minute health check of every Claude account (sign-in, credits, Fable).

entries.title: Hold
entries.text: Puts this queued build on hold. It stays in the Queue in its place, but the dispatcher skips it until you release it.

entries.title: Release
entries.text: Takes the build off hold. The dispatcher can start it when its turn comes.

entries.title: Archive
entries.text: Moves the build to the Archive tab, out of the working tabs. Unarchive brings it back.

entries.title: Unarchive
entries.text: Brings the build back from the Archive: to Pending, or Complete when every step is done.

entries.title: Delete
entries.text: Deletes the build. It moves to the Deleted tab and stays saved there for good. Restore brings it back.

entries.title: Restore
entries.text: Brings a deleted build back where it was. A build deleted from the Queue comes back in Pending.

entries.title: Select all
entries.text: Selects every build in this tab so one action runs on all of them. Builds that cannot take the action are skipped and listed.

entries.title: Select
entries.text: Adds this build to the selection for the bulk actions above the cards.

entries.title: Build archive
entries.text: Opens the Archive: every completed and archived build.

entries.title: Deleted builds
entries.text: Opens the Deleted tab: every deleted build, kept for good and restorable.

entries.title: Groups
entries.text: Your own groups of builds (Console app, UI, Urgent…): each sorted by state from partial to landed with a count per state. Drag Pending builds in, or pick them and tap Add to group.

entries.title: Build groups
entries.text: Opens the Groups board, or one group's own tab (build-orchestrator.groups:<group>).

entries.title: Groups board
entries.text: Every group with its builds sorted by state and its counts. Drag a build onto a group to add it, onto 'Pending, in no group' to take it out; drag a group to reorder.

entries.title: New group
entries.text: Name a group and tap Add group: it gets its own tab next to Pending. Change the tab in the editor.

entries.title: Edit group
entries.text: Rename, recolour, move up or down, pin it as a tab next to any stage (or every stage), change the sort, the states shown and its smart rule, or delete it (its builds stay).

entries.title: Smart rule
entries.text: A smart group takes in every build that matches by itself: title contains a word, more than N commits behind main, filed in the last N days (0 = today). Hand-picked builds stay too.

entries.title: Group actions
entries.text: Queue all sends every Pending build of the group to the Queue; Land all puts its Done builds first in the merge queue; Archive all; Set for all changes every build's priority.

entries.title: Land all
entries.text: Every Done build of the group goes first in the merge queue (tagged Urgent); the merge queue lands it when its PR is ready.

entries.title: Add to group
entries.text: Puts the selected builds into the group picked next to it. A build can be in more than one group.

entries.title: Take out of its group
entries.text: Takes the selected builds out of the groups they are in. The builds themselves stay where they are.

entries.title: Tab
entries.text: Shows this group as its own tab next to the stage you pick (Pending, Queue, Building…), or no tab.

entries.title: More than N behind main
entries.text: Smart rule: the group also takes every build whose branch is more than this many commits behind main. Empty = not used.

entries.title: Filed in the last N days (0 = today)
entries.text: Smart rule: the group also takes every build filed in the last N days; 0 means today only. Empty = not used.

entries.title: Save rule
entries.text: Saves the smart rule above (title contains, behind main, filed in the last N days); matching builds join the group by themselves.

entries.title: Clear rule
entries.text: Removes the group smart rule. Builds added by hand stay in the group.

entries.title: Archive all
entries.text: Moves every build of the group that has no live session to the Archive.

entries.title: Set for all
entries.text: Gives every build of the group the priority picked next to it (Urgent, High, Normal, Low).
